text:
Kyle Burroughs got the call from the AHL on Nov 13 as Dallas battled injuries on defense, and he's played four games since, all wins. Stars coach Glen Gulutzan praised him and Trey Taylor this week, per Yardbarker.

He's a 31-year-old seventh-round pick from 2013 on his fifth NHL team, a depth defenseman who knows the role. He played 17:12 against Florida on Nov 15, when Dallas was down to five defensemen, and about 12 minutes otherwise.

The sample is too small to read much into. Dallas got 40% of the expected goals with him on at five on five in those four games. NHL Edge has his skating and shot near the bottom of the league, which is no surprise for a player whose game is positioning and blocked shots.

What to watch: how long he stays as the injured defensemen return. Players like him are valuable precisely because they can step in without the team losing much, and the Stars haven't lost with him in the lineup.
